capabilities: Organize notes into folder-based Collections and pin widgets to an Overview Pinboard
Visualize any metadata property as distribution charts, activity timelines, ranking lists, or calculation cards
Drill down from chart segments to a side panel of matching notes
Arrange widgets in a drag-and-drop grid with edge auto-scroll
Sync property schemas by scanning vault metadata in the background
disambiguation: Not a daily-activity or habit tracker; despite the name, it visualizes metadata from any notes, such as books, games, projects, or habits.
extras: Manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation is manual (download release files into the plugins folder), no Community Plugins marketplace install described.
intentEvidence: without requiring complex Dataview queries or JavaScript code
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to visualize note metadata into dashboards without writing Dataview queries or JavaScript code.

relations.evidence: without requiring complex Dataview queries or JavaScript code

summary: Dashboard plugin that turns note metadata into collections of interactive charts, timelines, ranking lists, and metric cards.
